verdict.rationale: Fireflies provides building blocks for prep: the transcripts API can filter past meetings by attendee emails, meeting search exists, AskFred answers natural-language questions about past transcripts, and post-meeting action items are captured. However, nothing shows the tool proactively surfacing a pre-call brief tied to upcoming calendar events, so the founder must query manually or build it via the API. Missing for 10: automatic pre-meeting brief tied to calendar events, open-thread/action-item rollup across prior meetings with the same attendees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
